//: It needs its own project because `e2e/` belongs to no workspace package, so
`pnpm -r typecheck` never looks at it — and Playwright transpiles specs with
esbuild, which strips types without checking them. Without this, a spec could
assert on a field that does not exist and the `e2e` gate would still be green:
a gate whose own source is unchecked is a weak gate.
`noEmit` and not `composite`, so it is a checker rather than a build input and
nothing in the solution file has to reference it.
